text: The Societas Europaea has drawn a less than enthusiastic initial reaction, plausibly because its rules are the product of years of negotiation and political compromise rather than a response to market forces.
citation: Christian Kirchner, Richard W. Painter, Wulf A. Kaal, Regulatory Competition in EU Corporate Law after Inspire Art Unbundling Delaware's Product for Euro (2004). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=617681

isBasedOn.name: Regulatory Competition in EU Corporate Law after Inspire Art Unbundling Delaware's Product for Euro

abstract: It has yet to be seen whether managers and investors view the SE as a viable alternative, but initial reaction has been less than enthusiastic, perhaps because the rules governing an SE are the product of years of negotiation and political compromise rather than a response to market forces.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: the SE as of 2004, shortly before it entered into force
